1.3.0 (47) — audit stage 1. Source safety and import honesty.

Idiom Apply now reviews the exact file/line and refuses stale source. Unsafe getter and early-return advice is advisory only. Async dependency downloads cannot replace a different project or newer editor source. Unsupported Go flags/targets/arguments are rejected instead of silently ignored.

Library: existing Files/iCloud libraries are opened without overwriting. Switching waits for current source to save. Coordinated library transactions reread fresh state, retain conflicting source as a separate project and make bounded backups. Please verify on your real Files provider: make a disposable project in each of two test libraries; switch between them, edit, restart and check both remain intact. Keep an independent export during beta testing. Physical provider synchronization is not yet verified.

Import: GitHub snapshots pin an exact commit. UTF-8 testdata/vendor/CI and JSX/TSX are retained within limits. Project > Import details lists retained paths and omissions. Binary assets/history remain outside this text snapshot; partial export is labelled. Legacy unpinned projects do not silently receive files from a moving branch.

Settings states the ordinary native execution limits: memory and captured output are bounded; tight-loop Stop and a guest filesystem-write quota are not guaranteed. The existing source debugger, educational offline npm/React subset and explicit local Gin replay remain available.

115 focused model/integration checks and 4 native UI checks passed, including the offline React terminal/full-screen flow. This candidate does NOT include the next lesson-draft/practice changes under development. No full-suite, physical-provider or airplane-mode device claim.
